rule: This ledger tracks findings that must not be patched into runtime until exact ownership/source reconciliation is pinned. It is not executable liturgical data.

issues.finding: B020 Epistle/lesson output may leak literal bilingual response debris around Deo gratias / Thanks be to God.
issues.requiredAction: Trace renderer/Proper composition. Preserve C0075 as Proper payload and C0076 as separate fixed response.
issues.resolution: B020 renderer composition now appends fixed C0076 only after resolved Proper C0075. Regression covered by tests/reader-text.mjs.

issues.finding: B026 Gospel output may leak literal bilingual response debris around Laus tibi, Christe / Praise be to thee, O Christ.
issues.requiredAction: Trace renderer/Proper composition. Preserve C0086 as Proper payload, C0087 as fixed response, and C0088 as priest-private prayer.
issues.resolution: B026 renderer composition now appends fixed C0087 and priest-private C0088 only after resolved Proper C0086. Regression covered by tests/reader-text.mjs.

issues.finding: QA.016 passes falsely when whole Proper containers are excluded from completeness coverage.
issues.requiredAction: Retire legacy QA.016 as a merge authority after replacement CI and fixture coverage are certified.
issues.resolution: Replacement Proper-container coverage is in CI and session-level Proper v2 validation; legacy QA.016 remains non-authoritative.

issues.finding: Gloria/Credo cue duplication or overstrong bow ownership has been reported.
issues.requiredAction: Separate textual cue ownership from posture/gesture state and identify duplicate canonical/runtime IDs before patching.

issues.finding: B016 English assembly yields 'Glory to God in the highest to God.' because AO.SM.C0053 and AO.SM.C0054 are semantically split in English.
issues.requiredAction: Repair English cue assembly/segmentation without altering the Latin Glória in excélsis Deo or unrelated cue timing.
issues.resolution: Display-only composite AO.SM.C0053+AO.SM.C0054 renders 'Glory to God in the highest.' while preserving sourceCueIds and canonical ritual timing.

issues.finding: B037 English Lavabo contains the doxology twice: once with V/R labels and again as duplicate plain text.
issues.requiredAction: Identify the exact B037 English cue/unit ownership and remove only the duplicate projection; preserve the single canonical doxology.
issues.resolution: Lavabo English projection is deduplicated so the doxology appears once in both Low and Sung reader corpora; canonical ritual timing is unchanged.

issues.finding: Confiteor accent discrepancy reported: orare vs oráre.
issues.requiredAction: Locate exact canonical block/cue and source witness before patch.

issues.finding: Fixture provenance defects reported in the source-audit lane.
issues.requiredAction: Pin affected fixtures and provenance fields before changing source hierarchy.
